from pathlib import Path
import json,re,collections

event_id="1791189806-19cb6b264c6d"
base=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
raw=None
where=None
for d in ("sent","inflight","outbox"):
    p=base/d/f"{event_id}.json"
    if p.is_file():
        obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace"))
        raw=str(obj.get("message") or "")
        where=str(p)
        break
if raw is None:
    print("GROUPED=EVENT_MISSING")
    raise SystemExit(42)

m=re.search(r'DIFFERENT_PATHS=(\[[^\n]*?\])\s*\|\| COUNT=',raw)
if not m:
    print("GROUPED=LIST_NOT_FOUND || FILE="+str(where))
    raise SystemExit(42)

paths=json.loads(m.group(1))
groups=collections.OrderedDict()
for p in paths:
    parent,name=p.rsplit("/",1)
    groups.setdefault(parent,[]).append(name)

parts=[]
for parent,names in groups.items():
    parts.append(parent+"={"+",".join(names)+"}")
print("GROUPED="+" | ".join(parts)+" || COUNT="+str(len(paths)),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(42)
